about: Modwerk source-only midi-expression package for Digitakt I OS 1.54, compiled from sdk/digitakt/modules/midi-expression.

mods.title: Digi Expression
mods.summary: Pitch bend, aftertouch, the mod wheel, breath and velocity from MIDI IN play a MIDI track's synth and the Digitakt's own audio tracks, with each track's routings on an EXPRESSION page in SETTINGS.
mods.description: Pitch bend, aftertouch, the mod wheel, breath and velocity from MIDI IN play a MIDI track's synth and the Digitakt's own audio tracks, with each track's routings on an EXPRESSION page in SETTINGS.
mods.author: tekomelu
mods.on_unit: 0.12.4 tested on a Digitakt I by the author over DIN and USB; 0.13.0 tested in digiemu, the author's unit check is pending.
